en: {player}! Over here! The ferry was so fast I didn't think you'd make it before the malasadas were gone.
Welcome to Ula'ula, cousin. This island is the biggest of the four, and its trials are the toughest yet.
Captain Sophocles is waiting at the observatory on Mount Hokulani, up Route 10. After that comes Tapu Village, and Acerola's trial.
Hey, before we go anywhere, let's battle! I've got a new Pokémon since the last time, and I want you to see it!
Whoa! Even with a Z-Move, you were faster than me. I'll catch up. Just you wait!
Woo! That's what I like to see. Off you go, then. I'll be in my lab, taking Z-Moves on the chin.
Route 10 leads to the observatory on Mount Hokulani. The air's thin, so mind your lungs!
Go on, I'll catch up! After a malasada or two.
The ferry's for trial-goers on their way from Aether Paradise. Come back once you've seen the Foundation.
The ferry pulled away from Malie City's pier...
The ferry pulled away from Malie City's pier and out across the sea to Poni Island...
